prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Keir Starmer was appointed prime minister in July 2024, after leading the Labour Party to victory in the general election—the first Labour election win since Tony Blair’s in 2005.
